tests.protocol: source-independent anchors from fast-wind windows; train source probe on fast windows; evaluate later slow-wind windows; K=4/6/8 anchors; window sizes 5/10/20 s; three held-time configurations
AR coefficients + autocorrelation + low-frequency spectral power as a lightweight Koopman/spectral proxy; same fast-train/slow-held protocol

decision: Platonic/relative geometry remains an interesting auxiliary representation idea but lacks a strong enough existing-data discriminator for M1.
Koopman/spectral dynamics is rejected as current M1 because source location behaves more like a forcing/input than a transport operator and the proxy is not robustly superior.
